items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 18:1
items.html: And you need to know that Atik is an intermediary between AK and Atzilut, meaning that both restrictions apply to it. For on the part of the Malchut of AK clothed within it, it is considered like AK, meaning of the first restriction, which ends at the point of this world. However, on the part of its own screen, it is considered the second restriction, and it ends at the Parsa between Atzilut and Beria, like the rest of the Partzufim of Atzilut. You also know that those AHP of the ten Sefirot of NHY of AK, in whose measure is the place for BYA, are considered only NHY of NHY, since the Bina that goes outward is only from her ZAT downward, but in her GAR, which are the light of Hassadim, the matter of going out does not apply at all, since the light of Hassadim is never restricted and never coarsened, for the whole matter of restriction applies only to the light of Hochma. It follows that only ZON of Bina, and the true ZON, went out beyond Atzilut. And through the power of the illumination of the correction of the lines, the HGT of ZON were also raised to Atzilut, so that the KHB HGT of the ten Sefirot of these NHY remained within Atzilut, and only NHY alone went out from them to Beria. And when you divide them by the secret of the thirds, you find that of the two upper thirds of each line — namely Hochma-Hesed of the right line, Bina-Gevura of the left line, and Daat-Tifferet of the middle line — remained within Atzilut, and only the lower thirds went out to Beria, namely Netzah of the right line and Hod of the left line, meaning the lower third of the right and the lower third of the left. But the lower third of the middle line is not present here in NHY of AK, since the whole illumination of the middle line is Yesod, and in Yesod there are only two thirds, as is known, and it has no lower third. Hence Atik, too, on the part of the Malchut of AK clothed within it, is likewise drawn down to the point of this world, and hence the two lower thirds of its Netzah and Hod go out to BYA — just like AK. (Inner Light, page 641, Sub Header, “And It Is Found”)
